original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-coherent-over-first-order-thickening}
Let
$$
\xymatrix{
X \ar[d] \ar[r]_i & X' \ar[d] \\
T \ar[r] & T'
}
$$
be a cartesian square of algebraic spaces where $T \to T'$ is a first
order thickening. Let $\mathcal{F}'$ be an $\mathcal{O}_{X'}$-module
flat over $T'$. Set $\mathcal{F} = i^*\mathcal{F}'$. The following
are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\mathcal{F}'$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_{X'}$-module
of finite presentation,
\item $\mathcal{F}'$ is an $\mathcal{O}_{X'}$-module of finite presentation,
\item $\mathcal{F}$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-module
of finite presentation,
\item $\mathcal{F}$ is an $\mathcal{O}_X$-module of finite presentation,
\end{enumerate}

statement: Let $T\to T'$ be a first-order thickening of algebraic spaces and $X'$ an algebraic space over $T'$. Set $X=X'\times_{T'}T$ and let $i:X\to X'$ denote the base-change immersion. Suppose $\mathcal{F}'$ is an $\mathcal{O}_{X'}$-module flat over $T'$ and set $\mathcal{F}=i^*\mathcal{F}'$. The following four conditions are equivalent: (1) $\mathcal{F}'$ is quasi-coherent of finite presentation; (2) $\mathcal{F}'$ is of finite presentation; (3) $\mathcal{F}$ is quasi-coherent of finite presentation; (4) $\mathcal{F}$ is of finite presentation.
